name: Radiography Testing (X-Ray & Gamma Ray)
shortDescription: Uses X-Ray or Gamma Ray sources to view internal structure and detect flaws with a permanent record.
introduction: Radiographic Testing (RT) uses X-Ray or Gamma Ray (Ir-192) sources to view and assess the internal structure of an asset. RT is sensitive to corrosion, thickness changes, voids, cracks and material density changes, and can detect both surface and sub-surface defects with minimum surface preparation.
whyChooseUs: Largest fleet of Pipeline X-Ray Crawlers in Bangladesh
ASNT-certified radiographers with decades of field experience
Strict adherence to health & safety radiation protocols
Permanent film/digital record for every inspection

workingProcess.title: Site Survey & Safety Zoning
workingProcess.description: Radiation area is cordoned off and safety officer sets exclusion zone as per BAERA regulations.

workingProcess.title: Source & Film Placement
workingProcess.description: Test-part is placed between the radiation source and film/digital detector.

workingProcess.title: Exposure
workingProcess.description: Controlled exposure attenuates through material density/thickness differences.

workingProcess.title: Film Processing / Digital Read
workingProcess.description: Film is developed or digital image reviewed for flaws and defects.

workingProcess.title: Report Issuance
workingProcess.description: Certified radiographic test report issued as per applicable codes and standards.

name: Ultrasonic Testing (UT)
shortDescription: Detects surface and sub-surface discontinuities, corrosion and cracks using ultrasonic waves.
introduction: Conventional Ultrasonic Testing (UT) measures the propagation of mechanical vibrations through a material to examine properties, measure thickness and detect discontinuities including corrosion/erosion, flaws and cracks, supplying accurate readings on size and shape.
whyChooseUs: Calibrated Olympus/Sonatest flaw detectors
Certified NDE Level II UT technicians
Suitable for both new construction and in-service inspection
Fast turnaround reporting

workingProcess.title: Surface Preparation
workingProcess.description: Test surface cleaned and couplant applied.

workingProcess.title: Probe Calibration
workingProcess.description: Flaw detector calibrated against reference blocks.

workingProcess.title: Scanning
workingProcess.description: Probe scanned across weld/material to capture reflected signals.

workingProcess.title: Defect Evaluation
workingProcess.description: Signals evaluated against acceptance criteria.

workingProcess.title: Report Issuance
workingProcess.description: UT report with defect location, size and disposition issued.

name: Ultrasonic Thickness Gauging (UTG)
shortDescription: Accurate wall-thickness measurement for corrosion monitoring on pipes, plates and vessels.
introduction: UTG provides accurate wall-thickness measurement to monitor corrosion and erosion on piping, plates and pressure vessels, forming a core part of in-service inspection and Risk Based Inspection (RBI) programs.
whyChooseUs: High-precision Olympus 38DL Plus gauges
Suitable for hot-tap and in-service assets
Trend/aging data for corrosion management

workingProcess.title: Grid Marking
workingProcess.description: Measurement points marked per inspection plan.

workingProcess.title: Coupling & Reading
workingProcess.description: Gauge readings taken at each grid point.

workingProcess.title: Data Compilation
workingProcess.description: Readings compiled into a thickness map/report.

name: Magnetic Particle Inspection (MPI)
shortDescription: Quick, cost-effective method to detect surface and near-surface discontinuities.
introduction: In MT, the ferromagnetic material is magnetized and finely-milled iron particles coated with a dye pigment are applied. Particles cluster over discontinuities, making them visible under proper lighting conditions.
whyChooseUs: Portable electromagnetic yokes & permanent magnets
Fast on-site turnaround
Ideal for weld root/toe crack detection

workingProcess.title: Surface Cleaning
workingProcess.description: Test area cleaned of scale, oil and dirt.

workingProcess.title: Magnetization
workingProcess.description: Yoke or prod applies magnetic field to the part.

workingProcess.title: Particle Application
workingProcess.description: Magnetic ink/powder applied to reveal indications.

workingProcess.title: Evaluation & Demagnetization
workingProcess.description: Indications evaluated, part demagnetized after test.

name: Dye Penetrant Testing (DPT)
shortDescription: Low-cost method for finding surface-breaking discontinuities on smooth, nonporous surfaces.
introduction: PT finds surface-breaking discontinuities on relatively smooth, nonporous surfaces. It is low-cost, works on complex geometries, and requires no disassembly of the asset.
whyChooseUs: Non-destructive to base material
Works on non-ferromagnetic materials unlike MT
Portable aerosol kits for remote sites

workingProcess.title: Pre-cleaning
workingProcess.description: Surface cleaned and dried.

workingProcess.title: Penetrant Application
workingProcess.description: Dye penetrant applied and given dwell time.

workingProcess.title: Excess Removal
workingProcess.description: Excess penetrant cleaned off the surface.

workingProcess.title: Developer & Inspection
workingProcess.description: Developer applied; indications inspected and recorded.

name: Phased Array Ultrasonic Testing (PAUT)
shortDescription: Computer-controlled ultrasonic beam array for fast, highly efficient weld defect detection.
introduction: PAUT uses arrays of ultrasonic beams that are computer-controlled and steered electronically, capturing hundreds of signals at once for fast, highly efficient defect detection with a permanent digital record — also used for corrosion mapping.
whyChooseUs: OMNISCAN SX, PRISMA & PHASCON instruments
No dead-zone — detects defects at surface and in volume
Detailed depth & height positioning of defects

workingProcess.title: Weld Mapping
workingProcess.description: Weld geometry and scan plan configured in the instrument.

workingProcess.title: Calibration
workingProcess.description: Phased array probe calibrated on reference blocks.

workingProcess.title: Scanning
workingProcess.description: Probe scanned along weld capturing full volumetric data.

workingProcess.title: Analysis & Reporting
workingProcess.description: Defects sized and reported with digital record.

name: Time of Flight Diffraction (TOFD)
shortDescription: Advanced ultrasonic method to detect and size planar defects and cracks in welds.
introduction: TOFD detects planar defects and cracks not perpendicular to the measured surface. Defect height is exactly determined, and the high probability of detection (POD) greatly improves risk reduction and sizing accuracy.
whyChooseUs: High accuracy defect sizing
Fast scanning speed for long welds
Complements PAUT for full weld volume coverage

workingProcess.title: Probe Setup
workingProcess.description: Transmitter/receiver probes positioned either side of weld.

workingProcess.title: Scanning
workingProcess.description: Probes scanned along weld length capturing diffracted signals.

workingProcess.title: Sizing & Reporting
workingProcess.description: Defect height/length sized and reported.

name: Long Range Ultrasonic Testing (LRUT)
shortDescription: Remotely analyzes pipelines for corrosion and flaws over long distances.
introduction: LRUT is used to remotely analyze assets for corrosion and flaws over long distances without direct contact — rapidly inspecting pipelines and piping systems with minimal insulation removal, quickly localizing cracking and corrosion damage.
whyChooseUs: Covers long pipeline runs from a single access point
Minimal insulation removal reduces downtime
Ideal for road/river crossings & inaccessible sections

workingProcess.title: Collar Installation
workingProcess.description: Transducer ring/collar installed at a single access point.

workingProcess.title: Guided Wave Transmission
workingProcess.description: Guided ultrasonic waves sent in both directions along the pipe.

workingProcess.title: Signal Analysis
workingProcess.description: Reflections analyzed to localize corrosion/defect zones.

name: Positive Material Identification (PMI)
shortDescription: Identifies metal grade and alloy composition for critical plant materials.
introduction: PMI identifies the composition of components and materials, providing grade and alloy information. Correct material verification is critical for vessels, piping, valves and pumps to avoid failure from incorrect material use.
whyChooseUs: Handheld XRF analyzers for on-site testing
Non-destructive to the component
Essential for turnaround & procurement verification

workingProcess.title: Surface Prep
workingProcess.description: Test surface lightly cleaned/ground if required.

workingProcess.title: XRF Scan
workingProcess.description: Analyzer scans the component to read alloy composition.

workingProcess.title: Grade Reporting
workingProcess.description: Material grade compared against specification and reported.
